svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print upside down on its top, in ASA in an enclosed printer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shell 90 mm across, 71 mm tall, 3 mm wall, 20 mm round top edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three bosses 9 mm across, 10 mm tall, inside the foot on a 60 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: circle at 60, 180 and 300 degrees, each tied to the wall by a rib.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press an M3 brass heat-set insert into each boss with a soldering iron.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat pad on the pole side (180 degrees): 24 x 24 mm, 6 mm thick, face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0.5 mm outside the base edge, centre 27.6 mm above the dome foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16.2 mm hole through it for the M12 socket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Light pipe hole 8.2 mm at the top centre, with a 10 mm sleeve inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gasket: cut a ring 90 mm outside, 84 mm inside from 1 mm EPDM sheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: foot on the gasket; three M3 x 30 screws from under the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the foot sits flat on the base all round, no light under it.
